name: Shree Hanuman Sugar & Industri
summary: Shree Hanuman Sugar & Industries Ltd. specializes in producing a variety of sugar-based goods. The firm conducts its operations across two primary divisions: Sugar and Construction. Its product portfolio encompasses refined sugar, alongside industrial byproducts like bagasse, press mud, and molasses. Rawatmullji Nopany and Rameshwarlallji Nopany established the enterprise on January 19, 1932, and its corporate headquarters are located in Kolkata, India.
